gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all permission schemes to understand the access levels across different projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all permission schemes with their details, including scheme IDs and names.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new permission scheme to manage user access for a new project.
gold.ideal: The API should create a new permission scheme and return the details of the created scheme, including its ID.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an existing permission scheme that is no longer needed.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the permission scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to view the details of a specific permission scheme to understand its configuration.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified permission scheme, including its permissions and associated projects.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to update an existing permission scheme to modify user access levels.
gold.ideal: The API should update the permission scheme and return the updated details, confirming the changes.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to see all permission grants associated with a specific permission scheme.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all permission grants for the specified permission scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to add a new permission grant to a permission scheme to enhance user access.
gold.ideal: The API should create the new permission grant and return its details, including the grant ID.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to remove a specific permission grant from a permission scheme.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the permission grant and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to view the details of a specific permission grant to ensure it is correctly configured.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified permission grant, including its permissions and associated roles.
